facts.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch

setpoint.label: fire watch duration after completion of hot work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The provision and briefing of a competent fire watch must be provided, and its effectiveness must be recorded as a field verification before the task proceeds. The fire watch duration after completion of hot work must be set at 30 min. This clause applies to activities archived under CONTROL-OF-IGNITION-SOURCES at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
